set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED_REMOTE=9042559b2d052b2e1942c0a61220bd9b7e74c97f; git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller; test "$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller)" = "$EXPECTED_REMOTE"; test -e /dev/cu.usbserial-1130; python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, re, time
import serial
PORT='/dev/cu.usbserial-1130'
if PORT != '/dev/cu.usbserial-1130': raise SystemExit(90)
ser=serial.Serial(PORT,115200,timeout=0.20,write_timeout=1,dsrdtr=False,rtscts=False)
try:
    try: ser.dtr=False
    except Exception: pass
    try: ser.rts=False
    except Exception: pass
    time.sleep(6.0)
    ser.reset_input_buffer()
    def cmd(text, settle=1.6):
        ser.write((text+'\n').encode('ascii')); ser.flush()
        end=time.monotonic()+settle; data=bytearray()
        while time.monotonic()<end:
            chunk=ser.read(4096)
            if chunk: data.extend(chunk)
            else: time.sleep(0.03)
        out=data.decode('utf-8','replace')
        print('--- CMD',text,'---')
        print(out)
        return out
    cmd('status',2.0)
    cmd('sensors',2.0)
    cmd('sdlog status',2.0)
    listing=cmd('sdlog list',2.5)
    files=[(m.group(1),int(m.group(2))) for m in re.finditer(r'sdlog_file name=([0-9A-Fa-f]{8}\.JL) size=(\d+)', listing)]
    print('SDLOG_FILES',files)
    for name,size in files:
        if size<=0: continue
        length=min(384,size); offset=max(0,size-length)
        out=cmd(f'sdlog read {name} {offset} {length}',2.0)
        m=re.search(r'sdlog_chunk name=\S+ offset=\d+ size=\d+ file_size=\d+ eof=\d+ crc32=[0-9A-Fa-f]+ b64=([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)',out)
        if not m:
            print('SDLOG_DECODE_FAIL',name); continue
        raw=base64.b64decode(m.group(1))
        print('=== SDLOG_TAIL',name,'offset',offset,'size',len(raw),'===')
        print(raw.decode('utf-8','replace'))
finally:
    ser.close()
PY
